body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; Biomes! Caverns = living cavern. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat.
- Sky mountain: one connected rock texture per stone type (BM variant mode = sanctioned exception); outermost ring always AB_MountainTop lip; mined peak exposes open sky.
- Pod handoff LATE (22t). Below view PLUMB, dim 0.06. Mesa rejected.
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never `def.graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline.
- **Cross-level work: strictly-better rank only; main-thread only. MIGRATION DISCIPLINE: summary pre-gate + REAL virtual probe before any migration (colonists AND robots).**
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2 (run #72)**: SEMANTIC anchor rule (bound anchor on another map invalidates ANY giver answer, incl. cell-target jobs), not shape-based target checks. Lore updated.
- **FORCED-ORDER PARITY PATTERN**: cross-level right-click on a site that needs a THING the target level lacks -> "Bring {thing} and {verb}" option (carry + ABPendingOrders + forced vanilla giver on arrival). Instances: build (materials), install (minis), refuel (fuel). Extend this pattern for future cases.
- **TEXTURE POLICY**: user supplies stair/ladder/elevator art; risers on host atlases. Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only.
- **PARITY AUDIT IS THE ROADMAP**: docs/CrossLevelParityAudit.md.

## REFUEL FORCED ORDER (2026-07-23, user report "campfires still say need wood") — BUILT, compile green
Diagnosis: automatic refuel demand WAS registered (ShouldAutoRefuelNow true at 0 fuel; flows via push/fetch, subject to cache TTLs ~10s + Hauling-tail priority), but the FORCED right-click path was uncovered — RefuelWorkGiverUtility.CanRefuel searches only the campfire's map -> permanent "need wood" float option. Fix: ABConstructSupply.AddRefuelOption — clicked player building with CompRefuelable wanting fuel + target level has NONE of its accepted fuels + pawn's level can spare one -> "Bring {fuel} and refuel {thing}" (carry needed amount, FinishOnSite now resolves the "Refuel" WorkGiverDef for non-constructible targets). Watch in test: auto-flow latency (wood should trickle within ~10-20s with an idle hauler; Eager preset shortens).

## RUN #72 FIX — StationElsewhere rule (cell-target Goto loop), applied same day.

## BATCH BUILD (2026-07-23) — ALL P1+P2 BUILT, verification pending
Trade beacons column-wide; refuel/vat demand (+ forced order above); transporter manifests; surgery-bill ingredients; baby food; mech recharge routing; gear probes (apparel/weapon/drugs); non-Ideo gatherings; detectors: roof areas, childcare, mech repair. P3 excluded by design (Anomaly, anima, turrets).

## SAME-DAY PRIOR (verification rolling)
Install/uninstall parity; robot bounce fix (probe-gated migration); run #70 dock fix; fence patch; container-storage push fix; verify sweep; Achtung drags; meditation redirect; construction supply giver + bring-and-build; jobs settings tab (5 flow checkboxes); biome-driven plateaus; climb animations + wide stairs; art tuner.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior)
Priority-aware work; Misc. Robots base; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; risers; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat; pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode; modder API.

## SETTINGS — six tabs; jobs tab: presets + cadence sliders + 5 flow checkboxes.
## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; DEV: Adjust art (bake fold-in pending).

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots (verified) + Robots++ (probe-gated + StationElsewhere, unverified). Achtung! drags (soft, unverified). Container storage destinations (unverified). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: refuel forced order built on top of the full P1+P2 batch + all same-day fixes — ONE combined verification run still owed (trade/fuel incl. forced refuel/mech-charge/surgery/robots/gear/gatherings + earlier items). If auto-refuel still feels dead in test, next suspects: Hauling-tail priority starvation (consider a dedicated supply giver like construction's) and verdict-cache latency. Outstanding chores: translation report audit, palette pin watch, art bake fold-in, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
